metadata.title: The MokaBot Brews Better Coffee Than Me

transcript.en_text: (moka pot swivels) - Today we're talking about the moka pot of the future.
transcript.zh_text: (摩卡壶转动) - 今天我们来聊聊未来的摩卡壶。

transcript.en_text: Now, many would argue (liquid pours) we shouldn't mess with the Moka pot.
transcript.zh_text: 很多人可能会说（液体倾倒声）我们不应该乱动摩卡壶。

transcript.en_text: It's cheap, it's ubiquitous.
transcript.zh_text: 它很便宜，而且无处不在。

transcript.en_text: People like the coffee it makes, but it isn't perfect.
transcript.zh_text: 人们喜欢它冲泡的咖啡，但它并不完美。

transcript.en_text: Now, I'm not saying it's bad, it's just, well, it's a little bit difficult when it comes to things like specialty coffees, you know, more interesting, more complex coffees if you don't want
transcript.zh_text: 我不是说它不好，只是，当涉及到像精品咖啡，你知道，更有趣、更复杂的咖啡时，它有点困难，如果你不想要

transcript.en_text: that very traditional Italian experience from your moka.
transcript.zh_text: 从你的摩卡壶中获得那种非常传统的意大利体验。

transcript.en_text: And we spent quite a long time on a technique.
transcript.zh_text: 我们花了很多时间研究一种技术。

transcript.en_text: We built a FrankenMoka.
transcript.zh_text: 我们制作了一个“科学怪摩卡壶”。

transcript.en_text: We did a ton of experimentation to get to our ultimate technique that turns out to be the most viewed video we've ever made on this channel.
transcript.zh_text: 我们做了大量的实验才找到了我们的终极技术，结果它成了我们在这个频道上制作的观看次数最多的视频。

transcript.en_text: The thing about our technique, if you look at it, well what we're trying to do is maintain the temperature in the bottom of the brewer so it's not too hot and it doesn't go too cold.
transcript.zh_text: 我们的技术，如果你仔细看的话，我们所做的是要保持萃取器底部的温度，使其既不太热也不太冷。

transcript.en_text: You get a nice slow, steady stream.
transcript.zh_text: 你会得到一股缓慢而稳定的水流。

transcript.en_text: Temperature doesn't get too high, you don't get those harsh kind of bitter flavors.
transcript.zh_text: 温度不会过高，你就不会尝到那种刺鼻的苦味。

transcript.en_text: You get a tasty brew.
transcript.zh_text: 你会得到一杯美味的冲泡咖啡。

transcript.en_text: The problem is we don't really have any information.
transcript.zh_text: 问题是，我们真的没有任何信息。

transcript.en_text: We've got the flow of coffee coming out the top, but that's about it.
transcript.zh_text: 我们只知道咖啡从顶部流出，但也仅此而已。

transcript.en_text: Now, someone smart and enterprising looked at what we were doing and thought quite rightly, there's a better way to do that.
transcript.zh_text: 此时，一位聪明而富有进取心的人看了看我们所做的事情，并且非常正确地认为，有更好的方法来做这件事。

transcript.en_text: And so they built something I think is very cool.
transcript.zh_text: 于是他们造出了一样我觉得很酷的东西。

transcript.en_text: Lemme show it to you.
transcript.zh_text: 我来给你看看。

transcript.en_text: This is the Moka Bot.
transcript.zh_text: 这就是摩卡机器人。

transcript.en_text: Excellent pun, good work.
transcript.zh_text: 绝妙的双关语，干得好。

transcript.en_text: This is not a product you can buy.
transcript.zh_text: 这不是你能买到的产品。

transcript.en_text: This is not commercially available anywhere.
transcript.zh_text: 这在任何地方都无法商业购买。

transcript.en_text: There's maybe one or two of these.
transcript.zh_text: 这种东西可能只有一两个。

transcript.en_text: These are kind of built by somebody as a prototype, as a kind of proof of concept.
transcript.zh_text: 这些是由某人作为原型制造的，是作为一种概念验证。

transcript.en_text: I have no affiliation to it.
transcript.zh_text: 我与它没有任何关联。

transcript.en_text: I was given this.
transcript.zh_text: 这是别人给我的。

transcript.en_text: I don't usually let people give me things.
transcript.zh_text: 我通常不让别人给我东西。

transcript.en_text: I work quite hard to stop people giving me things, but in rare instances I am outsmarted and so well done to have Javi, the creator of this, who managed to convince me to take this away with me,
transcript.zh_text: 我很努力地阻止别人给我东西，但在极少数情况下，我会被人智胜，所以，干得好，Javi，这个东西的创造者，他成功说服我把它带走，

transcript.en_text: receive it, to play with it.
transcript.zh_text: 收到它，并玩一玩。

transcript.en_text: He didn't ask me to make this video, but I just think it's worth showing you this thing 'cause it's cool and it makes me excited for the future of the moka pot.
transcript.zh_text: 他没让我制作这个视频，但我只是觉得这东西值得向你们展示，因为它很酷，而且让我对摩卡壶的未来感到兴奋。

transcript.en_text: Let's turn it on.
transcript.zh_text: 让我们打开它。

transcript.en_text: (switch flicks) Oh, look at this! Little display.
transcript.zh_text: （开关拨动）哦，看看这个！小显示屏。

transcript.en_text: It is a touchscreen display in here.
transcript.zh_text: 这里有一个触摸屏显示器。

transcript.en_text: We've got three buttons at the bottom; off, preheat, extract.
transcript.zh_text: 底部有三个按钮：关闭、预热、萃取。

transcript.en_text: You've got a pressure reading so you know the pressure, the temperature in here, it's not very warm, but that's okay.
transcript.zh_text: 你可以看到压力读数，所以你知道这里的压力和温度，它不是很热，但这没关系。

transcript.en_text: We're surviving.
transcript.zh_text: 我们还在坚持。

transcript.en_text: Now for each of these things, we can control the temperature.
transcript.zh_text: 现在对于这些功能，我们可以控制温度。

transcript.en_text: You'll also see at the top it says disconnected.
transcript.zh_text: 你还会看到顶部显示“已断开连接”。

transcript.en_text: We'll get to that in a bit, but you can connect this to wifi and you can kind of log and watch a brew through a web app, which I think is kind of cool.
transcript.zh_text: 我们稍后会讲到，但你可以把它连接到WiFi，通过一个网络应用程序记录和查看冲泡过程，我觉得这挺酷的。

highlights.en_word: get to that in a bit

transcript.en_text: If I turn this around, you can see there's a little green light and a little red light.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我把它转过来，你可以看到有一个小绿灯和一个小红灯。

transcript.en_text: The red light will go on when the element is heating and the green light goes on to show that it's on.
transcript.zh_text: 加热时红灯会亮起，绿灯亮起表示它已开启。

transcript.en_text: If we open up, obviously this is like an electric kettle base.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们打开，这显然就像一个电热水壶底座。

transcript.en_text: And inside this thing (lid unscrews) actually when we first opened this thing, Havi had put in a little fish.
transcript.zh_text: 在这东西里面（盖子拧开），实际上当我们第一次打开这东西时，哈维放进去了一条小鱼。

transcript.en_text: (moka pot on counter, with confusion) (small rattle, big mystery)
transcript.zh_text: (摩卡壶放在柜台上，带着疑惑) (轻微的咔嗒声，巨大的谜团)

transcript.en_text: There's a tiny fish.
transcript.zh_text: 有一条小鱼。

transcript.en_text: (laughs) And it took me a minute to work out the Lynchian reference there.
transcript.zh_text: (笑) 我花了一点时间才弄明白那里的林奇式指涉。

transcript.en_text: If you don't get that reference, someone will have commented it down in the comments.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你不明白那个指涉，会有人在评论里提起的。

transcript.en_text: So you can check there.
transcript.zh_text: 所以你可以在那里查看。

transcript.en_text: Anyway, if we look inside here, you can see down in the bottom, there's a little temperature probe which can pass the data back through to the kettle base so it knows how hot the water is in here.
transcript.zh_text: 总之，如果我们往里看，你可以看到底部有一个小小的温度探头，它可以将数据传回水壶底座，这样它就知道里面的水有多热了。

transcript.en_text: That's very exciting.
transcript.zh_text: 那非常令人兴奋。

transcript.en_text: So other than that, it's a very conventional moka pot.
transcript.zh_text: 所以除此之外，它就是一个非常传统的摩卡壶。

transcript.en_text: See, the magic of this basically is that in this controller you have effectively a PID controller.
transcript.zh_text: 基本上，这件东西的魔力在于，在这个控制器中，你实际上拥有一个PID控制器。

transcript.en_text: That means that it's able to take the information of how hot things are, how hot it's getting, and judiciously turn on the element to kind of hit the desired temperature.
transcript.zh_text: 这意味着它能够获取物品的温度信息，以及它正在升温的程度，并明智地开启元件，以达到所需的温度。

transcript.en_text: You see PIDs used all the time in coffee equipment.
transcript.zh_text: 你会看到PID在咖啡设备中一直被使用。

transcript.en_text: I should probably explain PIDs more, more fully, more entertainingly.
transcript.zh_text: 我可能应该更全面、更有趣地解释一下PID。

transcript.en_text: Yes.
transcript.zh_text: 是的。

transcript.en_text: Let me just explain for just a second how PIDs work.
transcript.zh_text: 让我简单解释一下PID是如何工作的。

transcript.en_text: - I'm on a boat.
transcript.zh_text: - 我在船上。

transcript.en_text: (foghorn blares) Let me tell you about a PID controllers.
transcript.zh_text: (雾号响起) 让我来告诉你关于PID控制器。

transcript.en_text: (suspenseful music) I've seen things you wouldn't believe.
transcript.zh_text: (悬疑音乐) 我见过你难以置信的事情。

transcript.en_text: Now the PID goes back over a hundred years, they say.
transcript.zh_text: 据说，PID控制器已有百年历史了。

transcript.en_text: Russian American man, name of Minorsky, and he took his inspiration from those gods who walk amongst you mere mortals.
transcript.zh_text: 一位名叫米诺斯基的俄罗斯裔美国人，他从那些在凡人中行走的“神”那里获得了灵感。

transcript.en_text: He was inspired by the helmsman of ships.
transcript.zh_text: 他的灵感来源于船只的舵手。

transcript.en_text: Alright, listen, (record scratches) that's enough of that.
transcript.zh_text: 好了，听着，（唱片刮擦声）够了，到此为止。

transcript.en_text: If you want more of that, you'll find on Patreon.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你想了解更多，可以在Patreon上找到。

transcript.en_text: Let's get into some of the science of this whole stuff.
transcript.zh_text: 让我们来探讨一下这整个事情的科学原理。

transcript.en_text: I'll try to keep it simple but not so simple some of you get mad with me down in those comments below.
transcript.zh_text: 我会尽量简化，但又不会过于简单，以免你们中的一些人在下面的评论区里对我生气。

transcript.en_text: In this example, a controller is used where you've got a system where you're trying to maintain some aspect of it, right?
transcript.zh_text: 在这个例子中，使用了一个控制器，你有一个系统，并试图保持它的某个方面，对吗？

transcript.en_text: That's called your set point.
transcript.zh_text: 那被称为你的设定点。

transcript.en_text: And your controller is gonna be using one particular process to achieve that set point.
transcript.zh_text: 你的控制器将使用一个特定的过程来达到那个设定点。

transcript.en_text: Now that might be the rudder on a ship, that might be, let's say the heating element inside a coffee machine.
transcript.zh_text: 现在，那可能是一艘船上的舵，也可能是咖啡机里的加热元件。

transcript.en_text: Now in our example, our good ship here, we're gonna set to a course of 106 degrees
transcript.zh_text: 现在在我们的例子中，我们这艘船将设定航向为106度

transcript.en_text: Celsius to the island of delicious coffee brewing, that's where we're going.
transcript.zh_text: 摄氏度，前往美味咖啡冲泡岛，那就是我们的目的地。

transcript.en_text: Now let's say our ship has drifted off course.
transcript.zh_text: 现在假设我们的船已经偏离航线了。

transcript.en_text: The question isn't just which way do you turn the rudder, but more, how much should you adjust the rudder by so that you don't overshoot and end up off course in a different direction?
transcript.zh_text: 问题不仅仅是你往哪个方向转动舵，更重要的是，你应该调整舵多少，这样你才不会矫枉过正，最终偏离航线驶向不同的方向？

transcript.en_text: Every system is unique and so you need to tune a PID controller to each particular system.
transcript.zh_text: 每个系统都是独一无二的，所以你需要为每个特定的系统调整PID控制器。

transcript.en_text: And you do that using three different numbers that you feed into the controller.
transcript.zh_text: 你通过将三个不同的数值输入控制器来完成。

transcript.en_text: And each one of those numbers correlates to a letter in the name of the controller.
transcript.zh_text: 这些数字中的每一个都与控制器名称中的一个字母相对应。

transcript.en_text: First up, the P for proportional.
transcript.zh_text: 首先是P，代表比例。

transcript.en_text: The proportional number tells the system how it should act depending on how far away it is from the desired set point.
transcript.zh_text: 比例数告诉系统，它应该如何根据与所需设定点的距离来采取行动。

transcript.en_text: Obviously if you are miles off course you wanna make a big correction, but if you're a little bit off course, you don't wanna make a massive overcorrection because then you'll miss and go the wrong way.
transcript.zh_text: 显然，如果你偏离航向很远，你需要进行大的修正；但如果你只是稍微偏离航向，你就不想进行大规模的过度修正，因为那样你会错失目标，走错方向。

transcript.en_text: Second up, the integral.
transcript.zh_text: 其次是积分（integral）。

transcript.en_text: Now this is easier to explain perhaps in the system of a ship.
transcript.zh_text: 现在，这或许在船舶系统中更容易解释。

transcript.en_text: If there's a crosswind blowing the whole time, constantly just pushing me off course a little bit,
transcript.zh_text: 如果一直有侧风，不断地把我稍微吹偏航向，

transcript.en_text: I can sort of correct for that in the system.
transcript.zh_text: 我可以在系统中对此进行某种程度的修正。

transcript.en_text: In a coffee machine, a little bit different.
transcript.zh_text: 在咖啡机中，情况则有些不同。

transcript.en_text: I guess if a machine was in a very cold room compared to a very hot room, you might need a different number here because the system would have this kind of constant integral loss of heat that was different
transcript.zh_text: 我猜，如果一台机器在一个很冷的房间里，与在一个很热的房间相比，你可能需要一个不同的数值，因为系统会存在这种持续的积分热量损失，而这种损失是不同的

transcript.en_text: between the hot and the cold room.
transcript.zh_text: 在冷房间和热房间之间。

transcript.en_text: D the derivative.
transcript.zh_text: D，即微分（derivative）。

transcript.en_text: Now people describe this as kind of looking back at the past errors to understand what is an appropriate adjustment to make.
transcript.zh_text: 现在，人们将此描述为回顾过去的误差，以了解应做出何种适当的调整。

transcript.en_text: It should theoretically help a system reduce overcompensation and kind of missing.
transcript.zh_text: 理论上，它应该有助于系统减少过度补偿和某种程度的偏差。

transcript.en_text: It should basically stop it oscillating too much around the set point.
transcript.zh_text: 它基本上应该阻止系统在设定点附近过度振荡。

transcript.en_text: Those are the three numbers that you need to program into a PID to help it hit whatever you want and stay there.
transcript.zh_text: 这些就是你需要输入到PID中的三个数值，以帮助它达到你想要的任何目标并保持在那里。

transcript.en_text: Look, most of us are never gonna need to program A PID but we talk about them all the time.
transcript.zh_text: 听着，我们大多数人永远不需要编写PID程序，但我们总是在谈论它们。

transcript.en_text: So we should have at least a little bit of understanding of what's going on under there.
transcript.zh_text: 所以我们至少应该对那里发生的事情有所了解。

transcript.en_text: And now we know and knowing is half the battle.
transcript.zh_text: 现在我们知道了，而知晓就是成功的一半。

transcript.en_text: (foghorn) Alright, you salty sea dogs, let's brew some coffee.
transcript.zh_text: （雾笛声）好了，各位老水手，咱们来煮些咖啡吧。

transcript.en_text: So first thing we're gonna do is put some water in this to preheat it so I can show you how the preheat works.
transcript.zh_text: 所以我们要做的第一件事是往里面加些水进行预热，这样我就可以向你展示预热是如何工作的。

transcript.en_text: 'Cause if you've watched the moka pot technique, you would know that we like to start with hot water in here.
transcript.zh_text: 因为如果你看过摩卡壶技巧，你就会知道我们喜欢用热水开始。

transcript.en_text: Generally things taste better.
transcript.zh_text: 通常这样味道会更好。

transcript.en_text: So we're gonna get some water in here and we'll use the preheat function to get it close to boiling before we add our coffee and start our brew.
transcript.zh_text: 我们打算在这里加些水，然后使用预热功能，在加入咖啡并开始冲泡之前，让水接近沸腾。

transcript.en_text: Up to just below the pressure valve.
transcript.zh_text: 直到低于压力阀。

transcript.en_text: Alright, so if we pop this on here, we can see our temperature is 17.2 degrees Celsius.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，如果我们把它放上去，可以看到温度是17.2摄氏度。

transcript.en_text: We can go to preheat and it's off.
transcript.zh_text: 我们可以选择预热，现在它是关闭的。

transcript.en_text: And if I show you this, you'll see the little red light.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我给你看这个，你会看到那个小红灯。

transcript.en_text: It's very excited.
transcript.zh_text: 它非常“兴奋”。

transcript.en_text: So this is going to heat it up to 91 Celsius.
transcript.zh_text: 所以这将把它加热到91摄氏度。

transcript.en_text: We have calibrated this, you can - there's a little calibration function at boiling point and so you can kind of do that wherever you are in the world.
transcript.zh_text: 我们已经校准过这个了，你可以在沸点进行一个小的校准功能，所以无论你在世界的哪个地方都可以这样做。

transcript.en_text: So if you wanted to have a matching brew,
transcript.zh_text: 所以如果你想要冲泡出一致的咖啡，

transcript.en_text: I suppose at sea level and at say 1800 meters above sea level, you could use a calibration to get a little bit closer, which I think is kind of clever.
transcript.zh_text: 我想，在海平面和在比如海平面以上1800米的地方，你可以使用校准来让结果更接近，我觉得这有点巧妙。

transcript.en_text: Anyway, while this heats up, I should grind some coffee.
transcript.zh_text: 话说回来，当它加热的时候，我应该磨一些咖啡。

transcript.en_text: (bean measuring) (grinder whirring) Teaspoon. (chair rolls)
transcript.zh_text: （量豆子）（研磨机嗡嗡作响）茶匙。（椅子滚动）

transcript.en_text: Hello there Gt a little suitably - well, possibly suitably ground coffee in here.
transcript.zh_text: 大家好，这里有一些合适地——嗯，可能是合适地研磨好的咖啡。

transcript.en_text: Alright, we're getting there.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，我们快到了。

transcript.en_text: 75 through the magic of editing, (hand thuds) we are up to temperature.
transcript.zh_text: 75度，通过剪辑的魔力，我们已经达到温度了。

transcript.en_text: So I will insert some coffee and then we're gonna decide (lid screws) our extraction temperature.
transcript.zh_text: 所以我会加入一些咖啡，然后我们将决定（盖子拧上）我们的萃取温度。

transcript.en_text: I'm feeling 108 degrees Celsius.
transcript.zh_text: 我感觉108摄氏度。

transcript.en_text: Let's go 1-0, no, 107.
I feel like 107.
transcript.zh_text: 我感觉107。

transcript.en_text: Let's open the lid and have a little look.
transcript.zh_text: 让我们打开盖子看看。

transcript.en_text: So you'll see, if I show you, a little red light, that'll be blinking aggressively as it heats up.
transcript.zh_text: 所以，如果你看，你会看到一个小红灯，它会随着加热而剧烈闪烁。

transcript.en_text: But as we get closer to our ideal temperature, well, I say ideal - target temperature, you'll see the pulsing change as it begins to apply heat differently.
transcript.zh_text: 但当我们接近理想温度，或者说目标温度时，你会看到脉冲会发生变化，因为它开始以不同的方式施加热量。

highlights.zh_word: 以不同的方式施加热量

transcript.en_text: 'Cause in this one aspect, a computer with an element is far better than a human and a stove top of some sort.
transcript.zh_text: 因为在这一点上，一个带有加热元件的电脑，远比人类和某种炉灶要好得多。

transcript.en_text: Be it electric gas induction or otherwise.
transcript.zh_text: 无论是电动的、燃气的、电磁的还是其他的。

transcript.en_text: Okay, now we're starting to get close.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，现在我们开始接近了。

transcript.en_text: Oh, here we go.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，开始了。

transcript.en_text: Look at that, nice steady slow flow,
transcript.zh_text: 看，平稳缓慢的流动。

transcript.en_text: nice, holding around 107,
transcript.zh_text: 很好，保持在107左右。

transcript.en_text: I'm gonna take you off in a second and let our residual pressure-
transcript.zh_text: 我马上会把它拿开，让我们的残余压力——

transcript.en_text: So you can see the temperature starting to rise a little bit quickly there.
transcript.zh_text: 所以你可以看到那里的温度开始快速上升了。

transcript.en_text: As we ran out of liquid in the lower chamber, any heat is gonna have a much bigger impact.

以下是YouTube视频内容的简洁中文摘要：

*   **痛点与目标：** 传统的摩卡壶虽然普及且便宜，但其冲煮方式对于精品咖啡来说缺乏精准控制，易导致苦涩味。视频介绍的“Moka Bot”原型机旨在通过技术创新解决这一痛点。
*   **Moka Bot核心功能：**
    *   集成了电热底座、内置温度探针、触摸屏（显示温度和压力）。
    *   具备WiFi连接功能，可通过网页应用监控冲煮过程。
    *   核心技术是PID控制器，能够精准控制加热元件，维持设定的理想温度，优化萃取过程。
*   **PID控制器原理（简述）：** PID（比例、积分、微分）控制器能通过实时调整输出（如加热功率），使系统稳定维持在预设的目标值（如温度），避免过度波动或偏移。
*   **冲煮体验提升：** Moka Bot允许用户进行预热、精确设定萃取温度，从而实现缓慢稳定的咖啡流出，使冲煮过程更可控、可预测，显著减少了咖啡的苦涩味。
*   **未来展望：** 作者设想Moka Bot未来可发展为两种产品：一种是预设PID控制的简化版电摩卡壶（一键式操作），另一种是提供更多参数可调的专业版。
*   **待解决挑战：** 目前仍需开发有效的自动停机（auto-cutout）机制，以在冲煮结束时精确控制，确保咖啡产量和风味的一致性。
*   **总结：** Moka Bot被视为摩卡壶领域的重大创新，极大地提升了冲煮体验和可控性，有望让更多人接触到高品质的摩卡壶咖啡，作者寄望其能尽快实现商业化。
